content: निष्पेषः, -निष्पेषणम् .²1 Rubbing together, grinding, bruising, pulverizing; भुजान्तरनिष्पेष <ls>Ve. 3</ls>; <ls>Māl. 8. 9. 3</ls>. .²2 Striking, clashing, hitting against, friction; प्रक्षिप्य व्यनदन्नादं वज्रनिष्पेषनिष्ठुरम् <ls>Bhāg. 10. 55. 19</ls>; <ls>R. 4. 77</ls>; <ls>Mv. 1. 34</ls>; <ls>K. 56</ls>. .²3 The sound produced by striking or clashing.
